mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand growth regime (quarterly GDP growth > 3.0% and housing starts > 1,400,000 units), corporate earnings growth is robust, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high-demand growth regime (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized, HOUST > 1,400,000 units)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% and HOUST exceeds 1,400,000 units, or the regime signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate over the past three months signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE rises, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a significant labor market slowdown that depresses consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and increase in the federal funds rate indicates a contractionary monetary policy applied to a weakening supply chain, which reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls and FEDFUNDS rises, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-supply growth regime (industrial production growth above 2.0% annually), the S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to strong manufacturing and corporate capital expenditure.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 2.0% annually, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
